title: incident-bot: integrate slo-toolkit diagnostics + on-call helper shortcuts
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: surface SLO diagnostic results from the slo-toolkit into incident-bot runbook suggestions and add on-call helper shortcuts (quick-links to runbooks, suggested escalation commands). This reduces mean time to mitigations for SLO-related alerts by providing contextual diagnostics alongside runbook links.

What this PR does: integrates a lightweight adapter that queries the slo-toolkit diagnostics API for matched SLOs, enriches incident context with top-ranked diagnostics, and surfaces on-call helper shortcuts (copyable CLI snippets and quick links) in Slack/Teams notifications. Adds feature flags and rollout gating, unit + integration tests, and docs + changelog entry.

Checklist: [x] adapter implementation, [x] tests, [x] feature flag, [x] metrics/tracing, [x] docs, [x] e2e smoke in staging, [x] release notes.

Behavior summary: when an alert event contains SLO metadata or a detected slo_id, incident-bot will call the slo-toolkit diagnostics endpoint (with caching and rate-limiting), attach a short diagnostics summary (2-3 bullets) to the runbook suggestion block, and include 1-2 quick actions (e.g. "Restart worker group", "Restart inference pool", plus a link to the runbook). To protect runtime, the adapter honors a per-customer rate limit and a platform-level feature flag: feature.incident_bot.slo_diag_integration.

Rollout: feature behind runtime flag and rollout config: enabled for internal namespaces and 5% of customers in staging for 72h, then 25% for 48h, then global. Observability: new metrics incident_bot.slo_diag.calls_total, incident_bot.slo_diag.cache_hits, and incident_bot.oncall_helper.clicks_total.

Testing: added unit tests for adapter parsing and caching, integration test that stubs slo-toolkit responses, e2e smoke executed in staging workspace (passed). Manual QA: verified Slack message formatting and quick-actions work in staging workspace.

Notes: no breaking API changes. See linked Linear tasks for follow-ups (better ranking model for diagnostics, adding RBAC controls for quick actions).
